task_specification.objective: Complete the player-facing settings/pause module for the bound loop-04 candidate, replacing the combined prototype controls page with consistent state-bound presentation, real persistent options and safe nested navigation, while making existing evidence debt accurately inspectable without fabricating product state or acceptance.

diagnosis.root_cause: The settings/pause surface has a concrete implementation gap: ui/title_settings.gd exposes a small subset of preferences, while preview_controller.gd constructs a separate plain LOCOMOTION CONTROLS page mixing bindings, settings, saves and instructions. Separate audio volumes, persisted quality selection, camera-shake strength and damage-number settings are absent from the inspected preference authority. The three active ledger issues instead describe missing independent observations: previously committed histories cannot reproduce first-time notices, legal fault/life fixtures are unavailable, and deliberate obstacle negotiation was not observed. Repeating HUD layout tuning or resetting reward facts would not resolve those causes.
